rationale: The current brute-force permutation solver times out on all benchmarks (even n=5) due to n! growth and O(n! * n * m) complexity. This matches the observed failures and zero score. I will address this by prepending a complete NEH heuristic implementation (standard O(n^2 m) FSSP approximation that produces strong solutions on Tai benchmarks) via solver_lib. The NEH will be invoked directly by the solver below; pre_process additionally instructs it to prefer NEH over permutations, with a makespan evaluator helper. This targets the exact failure mode (combinatorial explosion) and should raise the continuous score toward the 0.792 best-known gap without external deps or complexity.
